name: How does AEO differ from traditional digital marketing for CPA firms?
description: AEO uses AI and data analytics to enhance traditional digital marketing for CPAs, offering more precise targeting, automation, and higher ROI.

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional digital marketing for CPA firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO distinguishes itself from traditional digital marketing by integrating artificial intelligence and advanced data analytics more deeply into every strategy. While traditional methods might manually research keywords or manage ads, AEO uses AI to predict trends, automate bidding, personalize content delivery, and identify high-value client segments with greater precision. This leads to more efficient resource allocation, higher ROI, and a more adaptive marketing approach compared to conventional tactics.
